name: hugo
description: Hugo site: .md, .markdown and .mdx content, Hugo shortcode and MDX component detection, shortcodes resolved from layouts/shortcodes and each themes/<theme>/layouts/shortcodes. Auto-detected from a layouts/ or themes/ directory, a hugo.{toml,yaml,json} file, or a config/_default/ Hugo config at or above content_dir, searching no further than the enclosing git repository.
